papers.title: Influence of 3D-Printed PEEK on the Tribo-Corrosion Performance of Ti6Al4V Biomedical Alloy
papers.abstract: This study investigates the tribo-corrosion behavior of Ti6Al4V biomedical alloy, when sliding against fused filament fabrication (FFF) 3D-printed polyether ether ketone (PEEK) pins in a phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) solution. This research aims to evaluate wear mechanisms and electrochemical responses under simulated physiological conditions, providing critical insights for enhancing the durability and performance of biomedical implants. Potentiodynamic polarization tests demonstrate that the Ti6Al4V alloy possesses excellent corrosion resistance, which is further enhanced under sliding conditions compared to the test without sliding. When tested against 3D-printed PEEK, the alloy exhibits a mixed wear mechanism characterized by both abrasive and adhesive wear. Open-circuit potential (OCP) measurement of Ti6Al4V demonstrates the alloy’s superior electrochemical stability, indicating high corrosion resistance and a favorable coefficient of friction. These findings highlight the potential of 3D-printed PEEK as a viable alternative for biomedical applications, offering rapid patient-specific prototyping, tunable mechanical properties, and improved surface adaptability compared to conventional materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究Ti6Al4V合金与3D打印PEEK的摩擦腐蚀行为，不涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not focus on additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it studies tribo-corrosion of Ti6Al4V against PEEK, without mechanical/fatigue characterization of the Ti6Al4V itself.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究3D打印PEEK与Ti6Al4V合金的摩擦腐蚀行为，评估其在模拟生理环境下的耐久性。
summary_zh.method: 通过动电位极化和开路电位测试，分析Ti6Al4V合金与3D打印PEEK对磨时的磨损机制和电化学响应。
summary_zh.result: Ti6Al4V合金具有优异耐腐蚀性，滑动条件下腐蚀性能增强，表现出混合磨损机制。
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证了Ti6Al4V合金在PBS溶液中的电化学稳定性和摩擦学行为。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to evaluate the tribo-corrosion behavior of Ti6Al4V alloy when sliding against 3D-printed PEEK in simulated physiological conditions.
summary_en.method: Potentiodynamic polarization and open-circuit potential measurements were used to characterize the wear mechanisms and electrochemical responses.
summary_en.result: Ti6Al4V exhibited excellent corrosion resistance, enhanced under sliding, with mixed abrasive and adhesive wear when tested against 3D-printed PEEK.
summary_en.validation: Experimental tribo-corrosion tests in PBS solution validated the electrochemical stability and wear behavior.

papers.title: Features of the Ti-6Al-4V microstructure and phase composition formation by changing the thermal cycle during the process of direct energy deposition
papers.first_author_affiliation: Saint-Petersburg State Marine University, World-class Science Center, Russia

corresponding_authors.name: Marina Gushchina
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Saint-Petersburg State Marine University, World-class Science Center, Russia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V DED过程中热循环对微观结构和力学性能的影响，与用户关注的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V力学性能相关，但未涉及疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue testing or S-N data provided; the paper focuses on microstructure evolution and strengthening mechanisms rather than cyclic/fatigue behavior.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热循环变化对Ti-6Al-4V DED微观结构和相组成的影响。
summary_zh.method: 引入层间冷却停顿改变热循环，使用SEM、TEM、XRD分析微观结构。
summary_zh.result: 增加停顿时间形成更平衡的组织，提高强度但降低塑性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微观察和力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of thermal cycle variations on the microstructure and phase composition of Ti-6Al-4V during direct energy deposition.
summary_en.method: Cooling pauses were introduced between layers to alter the thermal cycle, and microstructural analysis was performed using SEM, TEM, and XRD.
summary_en.result: Longer pauses led to a more equilibrium structure with increased alpha phase lamellae, resulting in higher strength but reduced plasticity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through microscopy and mechanical testing.

papers.title: High-Frequency Ultrasonic Impact Treatment Effect on Fatigue Properties of TC4 Titanium Alloy Laser Wire Filling-Welded Joints
papers.abstract: This study aimed to improve the fatigue properties of TC4 titanium alloy laser-filled wire welded joints. To this end, the highfrequency ultrasonic impact technology (UIT) was used to implement post-weld impact treatment on the welded part. Nondestructive testing of the phase composition, microstructure, microhardness, static and cyclic tensile properties, and fracture morphology before and after UIT were conducted and comparatively analyzed. The results show that the high-frequency UIT refines surface grains without affecting the weld phase composition, which is still dominated by the martensitic α' phase and does not form the ω phase. Due to plastic slip-induced strain-hardening, the microhardness of the weld surface layer is about 12% higher than before the UIT and about 40% higher than that of the base metal. Before UIT, long and thick cracks at static tensile fracture extend on the specimen surface; after UIT, the static tensile fracture surface is fine and smooth, and tiny cracks expand in the interior. The fatigue limit of the laser wire filling welding (LWFW) in the TC4 titanium alloy joint increased by about 29.4% after UIT. After high-frequency ultrasonic impact, cracks expand in the joint; the fatigue band spacing becomes smaller, and dimples are denser and deeper, while the fatigue limit load increases, effectively improving the fatigue resistance of the TC4 titanium alloy laser wire-filling welded joint.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TC4钛合金激光填丝焊接接头经超声冲击处理后的疲劳性能，属于后处理工艺对力学性能的影响，而非原始打印态性能，因此与本层方向关联度低。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on the effect of ultrasonic impact treatment (a post-processing technique) on fatigue properties of laser-welded Ti-6Al-4V joints, not on as-built or process-state mechanical/fatigue characterization of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升TC4钛合金激光填丝焊接接头的疲劳性能。
summary_zh.method: 对焊接接头进行高频超声冲击处理，并通过无损检测对比处理前后的组织与性能。
summary_zh.result: 超声冲击后疲劳极限提高约29.4%，表面微硬度提高约12%，裂纹扩展机制改变。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微硬度、静载拉伸和循环疲劳试验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the fatigue performance of laser wire-filled welded TC4 titanium alloy joints.
summary_en.method: High-frequency ultrasonic impact treatment was applied to the weld, followed by non-destructive characterization of phase, microstructure, microhardness, and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: The fatigue limit increased by about 29.4% after UIT, with refined surface grains and altered crack propagation behavior.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microhardness testing, static tensile tests, and cyclic fatigue tests.
